context:
First, update runtime query producers to emit `execution_time_seconds` using
monotonic elapsed measurements. Then update internal consumers (normalizer,
schema transform, exporters) to treat this key as canonical source.

Convert ms output fields only at serialization boundaries; do not reintroduce
ambiguous producer keys.

Enforce `execution_time_seconds` as float in schema validation boundaries so
serialization/deserialization does not silently truncate to integer values.
description:
Standardize runtime query timing outputs to one canonical key,
`execution_time_seconds`, and remove mixed-key result production in benchmark
execution paths.

This item addresses drift between parallel query execution implementations
(SQL adapters, DataFrame expression family, DataFrame pandas family) and
eliminates compatibility branching required solely because producers emit
inconsistent timing keys.

This TODO depends on the centralized clock foundation and applies its
monotonic methodology to all benchmark-critical query execution producers.
